summary: Teacher Messages Page Testing Complete - All features verified working. The page now uses the same email-like messaging system as StudentMessagesPage with 4 folders (Inbox, Sent, Archived, Trash), compose modal with rich text editor, recipient search, message detail view with action buttons, and green/teal color scheme consistent with teacher portal.
passed_tests: FRONTEND TEST 1: Teacher login successful - Redirects to /teacher dashboard
FRONTEND TEST 2: Messages page loads with data-testid='teacher-messages-page'
FRONTEND TEST 3: All 4 folders present (Inbox, Sent, Archived, Trash)
FRONTEND TEST 4: Compose button opens modal with 'Nuevo mensaje' header
FRONTEND TEST 5: Recipient search works - finds contacts by name
FRONTEND TEST 6: Subject input field present in compose modal
FRONTEND TEST 7: Rich text editor with toolbar (Bold, Italic, Underline, Lists, Alignment, Link)
FRONTEND TEST 8: Message list shows preview, date, and read status indicator
FRONTEND TEST 9: Message detail view shows sender info (name, email, photo)
FRONTEND TEST 10: Reply button works - opens compose with 'Re:' prefix and recipient pre-filled
FRONTEND TEST 11: Archive button works - moves message to Archived folder
FRONTEND TEST 12: Delete button works - moves message to Trash folder
FRONTEND TEST 13: Mark as read/unread button present and functional
FRONTEND TEST 14: Trash folder shows Restore and Delete Permanently buttons
FRONTEND TEST 15: Restore button works - moves message back to Inbox
FRONTEND TEST 16: Empty Trash button visible when trash has messages
FRONTEND TEST 17: Search functionality filters messages by subject/sender/content
FRONTEND TEST 18: Green/teal color scheme consistent with teacher portal (emerald gradient)

Folder_Navigation.trash: Working - shows trash count with Empty Trash button

Compose_Modal.recipient_chips: Working - shows selected recipients as removable chips
Compose_Modal.subject_input: Working - text input for message subject
Compose_Modal.rich_text_editor: Working - TipTap editor with formatting toolbar
Compose_Modal.send_button: Working - sends message and closes modal

Message_List.message_preview: Working - shows sender, subject, body preview
Message_List.date_display: Working - shows time for today, date for older
Message_List.read_status: Working - blue dot for unread messages

Message_Detail.date_time: Working - shows full date and time
Message_Detail.action_buttons: Working - Reply, Archive, Delete, Mark read/unread

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning about duplicate TipTap extension names ['link', 'underline'] - not affecting functionality
Minor: ESLint warnings about missing dependencies in useEffect hooks - not affecting functionality
seed_data_creation: None - used existing messages in the system
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teacher Messages Page fully tested and working. The page mirrors StudentMessagesPage functionality with email-like interface. Uses shared backend endpoints: /api/internal-mail/inbox, /api/internal-mail/sent, /api/internal-mail/archived, /api/internal-mail/trash, /api/internal-mail/stats, /api/internal-mail/contacts/search, /api/internal-mail/send, /api/internal-mail/{id}/reply, /api/internal-mail/{id}/archive, /api/internal-mail/{id}/restore. Color scheme uses emerald/teal gradients instead of indigo/purple from student portal.
